title: 第2章 我必须要给他正反馈
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

某一刻，比利苏醒了过来。

脚步声响起，他眯着眼睛，用手遮挡住刺目的阳光。

“醒了，嘿朋友…”

祖国人轻快地抬手招呼，语气里的得意快要溢出，他的欢喜简直溢于言表：“你可昏过去好一阵了，你可以待会再感谢我救了你，到现在…来吧，你会喜欢这个的。”

喜欢什么？

仅是一级的超级听力赋予了莱恩不为人知的听觉，早在祖国人从天而降的那个刹那，他就发现了期待已久的一幕到来。

这会听到祖国人话语中的促狭和不怀好意，莱恩差点没忍住笑出声。

按照常理来说。

他这一世的亲生母亲，也就是餐桌前的这个女人贝卡，她的爱人是比利·布切尔。

他应该是他们两个人的孩子。

但意外无处不在，尤其是在这个超级英雄…呃，超级恶人…该怎么称呼这群颠佬的世界呢？

总之，在这个世界发生什么事都不叫意外，而是喜闻乐见。

身为超级英雄的祖国人强了他老妈，所以导致他的亲生父亲人选换了一个角色。

等下发生的会面，不出意外就是祖国人的恶趣味以及报复，他要当着比利的面认他老婆的孩子为儿子。

莱恩配合地诧异出声：“妈妈，我好像听到外面有动静。”

说完，他跳下餐桌向门外跑去。

贝卡也急急忙忙地放下刀叉，心中还在想，沃特公司的人从不会在他们就餐时出现，发生了什么？

从出生时起，莱恩就有完整的上一世记忆。

穿越而来的他从未经历过什么胎中之谜，所以他对周围发生的事情一清二楚。

他清晰的记得，他的母亲贝卡为了他的安全是怎样艰难地与沃特公司周旋、抗争及妥协的。

母亲贝卡的一个观点，能打败祖国人的人，一定是与他同样血脉的人。

也就是他，莱恩。

沃特公司难道就不担心祖国人失控吗？虽然他们同样从小就给祖国人精心编织过人性弱点，可万一呢？

所以莱恩，继承祖国人血脉的超人类自然之子，就无可避免地成为了唯一制约祖国人的存在。

他是一个保险！

2岁时，莱恩自然觉醒了第一个超能力，热视线。

至此，他开启了金手指。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At some point, Billy came to.

Footsteps sounded, and he squinted his eyes and blocked the dazzling sunlight with his hands.

"Wake up, hey friend..."

The motherland man raised his hand to greet me briskly, and the pride in his tone was almost overflowing. His joy was beyond words: "You have been unconscious for a while. You can thank me for saving you later. Until now... Come on, you will like this."

What do you like?

Only the first-level super hearing gave Ryan unknown hearing. As early as the moment when the people of the motherland fell from the sky, he discovered the long-awaited scene.

Hearing the narrow-mindedness and ill-intentions in the words of his motherland, Ryan almost couldn't hold back his laughter.

According to common sense.

His biological mother in this life, the woman at the table, Becca, was married to Billy Butcher.

He should be the child of both of them.

But surprises are everywhere, especially in this world of superheroes...er, supervillains...what should we call these villains?

In short, anything that happens in this world is not an accident, but a joy to see.

As a superhero, the motherland raped his mother, which caused his biological father to change his role.

The meeting that happened next was, as expected, the motherland's evil intentions and revenge. He wanted to recognize his wife's child as his son in front of Billy.

Ryan said in surprise: "Mom, I seem to hear something moving outside."

After saying that, he jumped off the dining table and ran out the door.

Beca also hurriedly put down her knife and fork, still thinking in her mind, people from Walter Company never showed up when they were dining, what happened?

From birth, Ryan has complete memories of his previous life.

He had never experienced any mysteries in the womb when he traveled through time, so he knew exactly what was happening around him.

He clearly remembered how his mother Becca struggled to deal with, fight and compromise with Walter Company for his safety.

Mother Beka's point of view is that the person who can defeat the people of the motherland must be someone with the same blood as him.

That's him, Ryan.

Isn't Watt Company worried that the people of the motherland will lose control?Although they have also carefully woven human weaknesses for the motherland since childhood, what if something happens?

Therefore, Ryan, the son of superhuman nature who inherited the blood of the people of the motherland, inevitably became the only being that restricted the people of the motherland.

He is an insurance!

At the age of 2, Ryan naturally awakened his first superpower, heat vision.

At this point, he turned on the golden finger.
